messages:
maya-cs: Heads up — Wavefront Labs going live tomorrow morning APAC window. They need: add asia-southeast1 routing, temp QPS bump to 2k for 48h, and CIDR allowlist for their edge proxy. CC @ethan-netops @jonas-oncall :rocket:
ethan-netops: Got it. Can you drop the customer ID + IP ranges and exact window? I can stage the routing in dev first.
maya-cs: customer: wavefront-labs (acct wf-9987). IPs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/25. Desired window: start 2026-03-22T02:00Z for 48h. QPS current 500 -> bump to 2000.
jonas-oncall: Renewal touchpoint next week — they're in the renew-risk cohort but positive on adoption. Keep an eye on error rates during the bump. If latency spikes, rollback to 500 and open CS sync.
ethan-netops: copy. I'll push provisional routing and allowlist to staging now, then prod after you confirm. snippet for prod change:```json
{
  "route": "asia-southeast1",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"],
  "qps_limit": 2000,
  "auto_revoke": "2026-03-24T02:00Z"
}```
maya-cs: LGTM. Please set auto_revoke at 48h. Also add a quick alert: if 5xx rate > 1% over 5m, rollback.
ethan-netops: Will do. I'll create a short-lived policy and tag as `wf-9987-temp-bump`. Deploying to prod in the 02:00Z window unless issues in staging.
deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-4237 created for Wavefront Labs: apply allowlist & qps bump (wf-9987). Assigned: @ethan-netops. ETA: 2026-03-22T02:00Z.
jonas-oncall: I'll add a pager rule for the 48h window and a runbook note: if latency > 200ms p95, set qps to 500 and notify maya-cs + customer-success.
maya-cs: Thanks — please post back when prod change is active and when auto-revoke runs. I'll schedule a renewal check-in next Tue after the bump. :thumbsup:
